what: Logo letters over a dark curtain are hidden cell by cell (cell height = line height × 1.5, gap between cells .2 of that). When the typeface arrives the whole block turns on over .9s power2.out, and the letters rise from below their cell in .08s steps over .9s power3.out. Until the document and images have all arrived plus 2 seconds, each letter is followed by the same letter one cell below, and they roll up one cell at a time in .24s steps over 1.2s power2.inOut — it only stops where a full cycle ends, so the letters never misalign (8 seconds at most, unconditionally). When it stops it fires fx:done, the logo moves to the Hero wordmark position over .6s power2.inOut, and then the curtain lifts over .5s power2.out

options.to: Hero wordmark the logo moves to (css selector) — keep the same letter size. If absent, only the curtain lifts in place
options.max: Time to stop even if documents are late (sec), default 8
options.intro-each: Initial stagger for rising in (sec), default .08
options.move: Duration (s) of the move to the wordmark spot, default .6
options.row: Cell height multiplier (relative to line height), default 1.5
options.gap: Gap between cells (relative to cell height), default .2
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Logo letters to roll (children) — can be a group of spans with tight spacing between letters
options.fx:done: Event fired from the overlay when it stops and starts to move on (is-done is also added to the overlay) — hook the hero photo zoom-in, header and title rise here

from.where: shared.js preloader (.sn-loader — five-letter wordmark, 20.625rem·line .8, −2.0625rem between letters, moves to the .sn-hero__mark spot when done)
